name: Kamimori Kotone
source:
The protagonist's younger sister.
A first-year who enrolled at the school this year when her brother took up his post.
She lives with the protagonist, and trusts and adores his brother more than anyone else. She secretly desires to "become his wife", but...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc032/character/kotone.html] official site[/url]]
